purpose: Maps TP/STP Medal Shop accessory research records to canonical accessory identities while preserving historical pricing and rotation provenance.
matching_policy: A medal-shop route does not create a new inventory identity when the same accessory already exists in the canonical layer.
Historical prices are observations and are not treated as current prices.
TP Medal Shop and STP Medal Shop remain distinct acquisition routes/currencies.
Names that cannot yet be reconciled to an existing inventory identity remain candidates rather than forced matches.
